scope: Actor- and exact-origin-scoped restoration of the nested public member-profile route on Android, Web/Wasm and iOS

steps: SavedStateHandle accepts only the exact actor and root or conversation origin
failed restored-child Back invokes closeUserProfile so the retained parent is restored
NeighborhoodsAndroidViewModelRouteTest passed from a clean affected build
sessionStorage accepts only the exact actor and origin fragment
the failed restored-child focal Wasm browser test passed
the unchanged prior browser coverage remains applicable to the byte-identical Web runtime
UserDefaults accepts only the exact actor and concrete chat conversation origin
chat:sb:conversation-a and chat:sb:conversation-b remain distinct continuation origins
Swift parse, x86_64 framework link and unsigned Intel Simulator host build passed
two selected QuataFeedFrameworkTests passed on the booted iOS 26.5 Simulator

assertions: only successfully visible profiles are published to persistent storage
the snapshot does not insert the same immediate transition twice; a non-consecutive revisit remains valid history
Back publishes the valid parent before loading it
a failed restored child keeps the exact target for Retry and returns to its retained parent on Back
superseded and failed new opens do not add phantom entries
successful private-conversation navigation consumes the profile route before leaving
explicit close, incompatible deep link, logout, actor mismatch and origin mismatch clear the snapshot
Android and iOS distinguish two concrete conversations even though they share one destination family
independentReviewCorrections: The Android failed-load Back binding now closes the profile through the product model instead of only dismissing the error.
The iOS continuation origin now includes the concrete conversation identifier instead of collapsing every chat to chat.
The duplicate-history claim is narrowed to consecutive identical transitions; A to B to A remains valid history.

cleanup.mode: no backend fixture, credential, push delivery or remote mutation used

limitations: This closes the durable nested public member-profile route only; scroll, drafts, editor state, media position and unrelated secondary back stacks retain their own units.
iOS verification uses the authorized Intel Simulator and an unsigned host test build; it makes no App Store, APNs or physical-device claim.
GitHub final jobs retain clean-runner integrated certification.

validationProvenance.android: The affected JVM test passed with one worker, no build cache, Kotlin incremental compilation disabled and the compiler in-process after stale build outputs were isolated outside the worktree.
validationProvenance.web: The affected Wasm browser test passed under the same clean, single-worker Gradle policy; unchanged broader browser evidence is not repeated solely for the new SHA.
validationProvenance.ios: The exact Product SHA was bundled to the macOS VM, parsed by swiftc, linked as an iosX64 framework, built as an unsigned Intel Simulator host and ran the two selected XCTest methods successfully.
validationProvenance.supersedes: docs/candidate-attestations/evidence/shell-navigation-public-profile-backstack-ea566b85.json remains historical and is superseded for acceptance because independent review found two product defects and one overbroad assertion.
